protocol: Freeze before semantic prompt development; one final run after development selection. Do not tune on final outcomes.
primary: Exact answer status and exact evidence ID set; no prose preference. Secondary recall@3 for retrieval baseline, citation validity, abstention, association only on question-specific labeled subset. Confidence intervals are descriptive Wilson intervals, not generalization guarantees.
independence: Synthetic, assistant-authored, implementer-visible. Related wording/long distractors reduce effective independence. Human n=0.
